findings.fix: Put hp in a --ui-panel card (1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding) inset 48px from the left and bottom. Use a 16px 'hp' label and a 32px number in --tx-1. Make the bar 12px high with a muted fill, turning --danger below 30%. Match the ammo card's height.

findings.where: the long dock cache label, top right (1648,150)
findings.what: The location name is off-palette lilac text with no backing. It floats over the map, collides with the building art, and is hard to read. It also adds a second purple, which the guide doesn't allow.
findings.fix: Draw it in --tx-1 at 20px f-cond 600 with a scrim backing (rgba(6,7,8,.8), 8px 16px padding, 4px radius). Or fold it into the run info header. Align its right edge to 48px from the screen edge.

findings.what: The text is 14 to 16px and the 'dead' rows are --tx-2 on a map. Dead is not flagged in --danger. The first row 'you $1,647' has the same weight as the rest. The panel sits at about 8px from the edge, not 48px, and its border and fill differ from the other cards. The header 'current pillagers 0' is crowded against its chevron. It also repeats the footer 'out · dead' counts, so the same information appears twice.
findings.fix: Inset the panel 48px from the left. Use 16px rows with 8px padding and 16px side padding. Show 'you' in --tx-1 and bold, and the others in --tx-2. Colour 'dead' --danger. Drop either the footer counts or the per-row 'dead' tags.

findings.where: extraction indicators (extract 152m at the top centre, c 152m at the right edge)
findings.what: Extraction distance appears twice, in two pill styles with different type sizes. The right-edge 'c 152m' has an unexplained 'c' and sits on the map next to the run info card. The ring arc at the lower right is a third extraction cue with no label.
findings.fix: Keep one top-centre 'extract 152m' pill. Delete the right-edge text pill. If an off-screen cue is needed, use a bare teal arrow at the screen edge with no text.

findings.where: run info bar, top right (1603,18 to 1902,54)
findings.what: The bar is a thin black strip that touches the building and is only about 18px from the edge. It has a different border and radius from the scoreboard and ammo cards. Its 'run info' label is small, and it overlaps the building wall.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px from the top and right. Use the shared panel token (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius) with a 16px label in --tx-1 and a 32px height. Keep it the same width as the other top cards.

findings.what: Slot numbers 3, 5 to 0 and the ghost weapon silhouettes are faint and noisy next to the three filled slots. The selected slot has an amber border, but the guide says lime is the 'selected' colour. The amber also matches the P1 ring, which makes it ambiguous.
findings.fix: Hide the empty slot numbers and silhouettes, or lower them to 25% opacity with no numbers. Use a 2px --acc border for the selected slot. Make the slot number labels 16px in --tx-2.

findings.what: The ammo card is the best-built element, with a clear hero number. However it sits about 10px from the right and bottom edges, not 48px. The 'b / i backpack' hint is 14px and near the floor of legibility. The slash and max (24) are the same weight as the current count.
findings.fix: Inset the card 48px from the right and bottom. Set the hint to 16px in --tx-2. Make '/ 24' 32px in --tx-2 so 12 is the hero.

findings.where: status icons (bottom left, 24,940) and 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: The two round icons use amber and teal rings with no labels, which makes their meaning unclear. They sit tight against the hp bar. The 'f1 controls' chip floats mid-screen over the building art and is smaller than 16px.
findings.fix: Put the icons in the hp card row with 8px gaps and 32px diameter. Make the f1 controls chip 16px in --tx-2 on a --ui-panel backing, aligned to the 48px left margin.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD is readable and mostly lower case, but the edge-hugging panels, the unpanelled hp bar and the doubled extraction cues are the same problems as last review, and none of them has been fixed.

findings.what: The hp bar is a raw green slab with big text jammed against the bottom edge. It has no panel, no inset and no label hierarchy. It is the loudest colour on screen and sits right next to the quiet ammo card.
findings.fix: Put hp in a --ui-panel card (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding) inset 48px from the left and bottom. Use a 16px 'hp' label and a 32px --tx-1 number. Make the bar 12px high with a muted fill, turning --danger below 30%. Match the ammo card's height.

findings.what: The panel sits 8px from the screen edge, which breaks the 48px margin. All rows are the same weight, 'you' is not set apart, and the rows are crowded. Both the per-row 'dead' tags and the footer '0 out · 3 dead' say the same thing.
findings.fix: Inset the panel 48px. Use 16px rows with 8px row padding and 16px side padding. Show 'you' in --tx-1 weight 700 and the others in --tx-2. Colour 'dead' --danger. Delete the footer counts.

findings.where: extraction cues, top centre (960,60) and right edge (1823,487)
findings.what: Extraction is shown twice, as 'extract 152m' and as 'c 152m'. The 'c' prefix is cryptic. The right pill is a different size and style from the top one.
findings.fix: Keep one top-centre 'extract 152m' pill in --extract. Delete the right-edge text pill and keep only a bare teal arrow on the screen edge, with no text.

findings.where: 'the long dock cache' label, top right (1648,150)
findings.what: The label is lavender text floating over the map with no backing. It is hard to read against the busy art and it uses a colour that is not in the palette.
findings.fix: Draw it in --tx-1 at 20px f-cond 600 on a scrim backing (rgba(6,7,8,.8), 8px 16px padding, 4px radius). Right-align it to 48px from the screen edge, or fold it into the run info header.

findings.where: run info bar, top right (1603,18 to 1902,54)
findings.what: The bar is flush to the top and right edges, clipped by the screen, with a chevron and a flat dark fill. It does not match the scoreboard panel's border or its inset.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px from the top and right. Use the shared panel token (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius) with a 16px --tx-1 label and a 32px height. Make the left and right cards the same width.

findings.where: bandage tip and f1 controls hint (x16,y789 and x435,y940)
findings.what: Two small pills sit at random positions with different styles, and the controls hint floats over the map above the weapon bar. The controls hint is 16px or smaller with low contrast.
findings.fix: Put both on the same 16px label style and the same panel token. Anchor the controls hint to the bottom-left list position with a 48px inset, and stack the bandage tip above the hp card.

findings.where: weapon slot bar, bottom centre (555,957 to 1100,1060)
findings.what: The empty slots 3 and 5 to 0 are faint ghost icons with floating digits and no tile outline. The row looks unfinished, and the bar sits 20px from the bottom edge.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 100px tiles with a 1px --ui-line border and a 16px --tx-2 number. Lift the bar to a 48px bottom inset. Only the selected slot keeps --acc.

findings.what: The card is 10px from the right edge, so its inset does not match the other HUD elements. The '12 / 24' hero number is good, but 'b / i backpack' at 14px is below the 16px label floor.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px from the right and bottom. Raise the 'b / i backpack' hint to 16px --tx-2. Keep the 56px hero number.

v.verdict: This is a blank dark screen with only a tiny money, xp and stash readout in the top-right corner. The preraid zones screen (zone picker, title, actions) is missing or failed to render.

findings.what: The screenshot named preraid-zones shows no zones, no title, no cards, no primary action and no back/close control. About 99% of the frame is empty #0b0c0d. The player has nothing to select and no way to continue.
findings.fix: Render the zone picker: a 90% centred card with a 32px title, 3 to 5 zone rows or tiles, a lime-filled primary 'deploy' button, and an x in the card corner. If the screen is meant to be there, fix the capture timing or the render failure.

findings.what: No element is focused or selected, so there is no lime focus bar or highlighted row. A pad player would not know where they are.
findings.fix: Default focus to the first available zone. Give it a 2px --acc outline or a --ui-raised fill with a 4px lime left bar.

findings.what: Three groups sit in a single row with uneven spacing: '$900' at about 28px, '0' beside a tiny 'xp', and the stash and bag line at about 13px. The style guide asks for a vertical 1x1 list of equal-size items in this corner. The stash and bag text is under the 16px minimum for anything read. The '0' and 'xp' have no clear relationship, since xp is a tiny suffix on a large digit. With no screen below it, nothing explains the numbers.
findings.fix: Stack the items vertically, each at 20px f-cond 600 with a 16px label in tx-2. Use equal 8px row gaps, right-aligned to a 5% margin (96px from the right, 54px from the top). Raise the stash and bag text to at least 16px.

findings.what: The eye lands on '$900' in the corner because it is the only thing on screen. It is not the hero number and it is not the primary action, so hierarchy has failed.
findings.fix: Put a 32px screen title and a 56px hero element, such as the selected zone's payout or risk, in the card centre. Shrink the currency readout to 20px.

findings.what: A 1px light border or stroke shows around the whole frame. It is not part of any token (--ui-line is #2e3337), and it looks like a capture artifact.
findings.fix: Remove the stray outline, or use --ui-line at 1px on a panel border and nowhere else.

findings.what: Nothing in the frame says Pillagers or ARC Raiders x Zero Sievert: no map, no atmosphere, no accent, no panel. The lime accent appears nowhere.
findings.fix: Put a darkened map or terrain plate behind the card under the --scrim at 80%. Use lime only on the focused zone and the deploy button.

v.verdict: The hub reads as a busy sandbox with many same-weight tooltip chips, a hard-to-read top-right money readout and off-spec text, so it is not yet a polished, consistent menu.

findings.where: top-right currency row ($900, 0 xp, stash $3,916 bag $0)
findings.what: Three different type sizes and weights sit in one row, and the 'stash $3,916 bag $0' text is tiny, about 14px, and runs against the screen edge with no panel behind it. It sits over a dark void and the arena edge, so its contrast and grouping are inconsistent. It also breaks the guide's 'every item the same size' rule for the top-right list.
findings.fix: Put the money, xp and stash values in one top-right panel with 24px padding. Give them one size (--fs-body 20px, f-cond 600) and stack them 1 by 1. Use tx-1 for values and tx-2 at 16px for labels. Put the panel at x=1920-48 and y=48.

findings.what: The 56px-plus lime label with an exclamation mark is the loudest thing on screen, but it floats on a plain dark chip with no focus ring and no key hint. It is a different size and treatment from every other station label, and it sits under the lime/amber 'selected' semantics. It also has a retail-exclamation tone that clashes with the straight-copy rule.
findings.fix: Set it to --fs-title 32px f-cond 700 in --acc on --ui-panel. Drop the '!' (use 'enter raid'). Add a 3px lime underline bar and an 'e' key chip in 16px below it. Keep the other labels at 20px tx-1.

findings.where: the last pour label and '***experimental feature may glitch***' tag
findings.what: The warning tag is a second chip stuck directly under the station label with a 3-asterisk wrapper, orange text about 14px, and a wide box that nearly touches the label above. It reads as a hack and as an explaining sentence, and it sits on top of the character's head.
findings.fix: Remove the asterisks and shorten to 'experimental'. Render it as a 16px --warn word with a 1px --warn border chip, 8px below the label, aligned to the label's width. Or move it into the interaction prompt shown only when the player is in range.

findings.where: bottom centre stack: toast, controls list, hotbar
findings.what: Three stacked chips (a welcome-pack toast, the key legend and the 9-slot hotbar) are of different widths, each with its own border and fill, and they crowd within about 12px of each other. The toast overlaps the 'the stash' station, and the legend at about 14px is below the 16px floor, with 'wasd walk' and similar text in muted grey.
findings.fix: Use one shared 16px gap between the three. Set the legend text to 16px with tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, and align it to the hotbar's width (x 455 to 1465). Move the toast above the stash label (or top-centre) so it stops covering the station. Drop the toast to a single short line.

findings.where: station labels (wirt the gambler, the mainframe, shop craft and hire, settings, the stash, fashion)
findings.what: Every station label is the same dark rounded chip at the same weight, with no icon or sign of which station is nearest or focused. Their baselines are inconsistent: the labels sit at different heights above their pads, and 'fashion' overlaps a character and the pad ring. The identical-chip look is the template tell the guide warns about.
findings.fix: Give all labels one 20px f-cond 600 style and a fixed 8px offset above the pad. On proximity, grow the active one to 32px and add a lime 3px bar, and dim the rest to tx-2. Move 'fashion' clear of the characters by 16px.

findings.where: large translucent circles on the floor
findings.what: The grey, teal, purple and brown discs behind each station overlap each other (the mainframe and enter-raid circles, the centre circle) and muddy the floor with washed colour blobs. They compete with the lime accent and with the characters and add no hierarchy.
findings.fix: Limit it to one 2px ring per station at 30% opacity in the station colour, and drop the large fills. Show the filled disc only for the station in range, at 12% opacity.

findings.what: The title (about 28px) and the subline '7 items in stash · 0 runs' (about 14px) are in a small panel at x=81, which is not on the 5% (96px) margin and is not aligned with the currency panel at the top right. The subline is below the 16px floor and is a status sentence the screen does not need.
findings.fix: Move the panel to x=96, y=48, and set the title to 32px and the subline to 16px tx-2. Use the same panel fill, border and 8px padding as the top-right panel. Cut 'runs' if the number is not needed.

findings.where: overall scene: 14 characters in the lobby
findings.what: Many identical-scale characters scatter across the floor with no lead, so the eye has no start point. The black bars at the left and right edges and the grey frame look unfinished, and the pad focus state is not visible for a couch player.
findings.fix: Fill or mask the letterbox bars with --ui-void and a 1px --ui-line border. Add a lime focus ring (3px) and a key chip on the nearest pad, and dim the other stations to 70% opacity.

v.verdict: The screen now renders as a proper 90% card with a title, an x, a map, option columns and a lime ascend button, but three columns share the same visual weight and the small text is too small for a couch.

findings.what: The map, the conditions list, and the kit and pack panel are all dense and similar in weight, so the eye lands on the lime ascend button and then wanders. The 'cold storage' title is only 24px and sits in a sub-header, not as the screen title.
findings.fix: Keep the 32px 'pre-raid' title. Make 'cold storage' the 32px zone name in tx-1 and demote the stats line to 16px tx-2. Add a 2px --ui-line-hi border to the map panel. Give conditions and kit the same 16px label style and 16px column gaps.

findings.where: small text: 'no armour equipped', belt numbers 1-0, '/1', zone labels, map room labels
findings.what: These are about 12-14px, below the 16px minimum for anything read. The warning is orange text at about 13px beside a tiny glyph, and the belt boxes are about 30px with faint digits. Neither is readable from a couch.
findings.fix: Set all of these to 16px f-cond 600. Make the belt slots 40px with 16px digits in tx-2. Make the warning 16px --warn with a 24px glyph, and move it directly above the ascend button with an 8px gap.

findings.what: The prices are red ($2,340, $2,760) in a tiny font next to bold '$660' in white. Red here reads as 'cannot afford', which is accurate, but it is mixed with unlabelled blank cells for smoke canister and burst carbine. The price column therefore has three states with no explanation, and the rows have thin dividers and cramped 0/-/+ steppers.
findings.fix: Use one price style: 16px right-aligned, tx-1 when affordable and --danger when not. Show 'free' or a dash in the blank cells. Make the steppers 40px square with 8px gaps and add 12px more row height.

findings.what: The surface, weather and seed lists are 5 to 8 stacked rows with identical weight, and the '+5% sp' tags are small and low-contrast. Selected rows use a lime check, but the faint outline on the selected row is hard to tell from the idle rows.
findings.fix: Give the selected row a --ui-raised fill with a 4px --acc left bar. Raise the '+5% sp' tags to 16px --warn. Group the rows under 16px tx-2 labels with 24px between groups.

findings.what: The map is a blue-tinted panel with dark-navy room boxes that have no labels. It is the largest area, but its low-contrast blue-on-blue reads as a placeholder next to the neutral grey UI panels. Exit markers in teal are fine, but the purple dashed squares are unexplained.
findings.fix: Dim the room fills to --ui-panel and the map tint to 8% opacity, and draw walls at 1px --ui-line-hi. Keep the teal exits. Add a 16px legend for the purple squares, or remove them.

findings.what: The 'esc close' and 'click pick' key hints at the bottom are small, and a stray 1px outline runs around the whole screen outside the card. The card border is a hard line with no scrim falloff.
findings.fix: Set the key hints to 16px with 32px-tall keycaps. Remove the outer screen outline. Use a --scrim backdrop and a 1px --ui-line-hi card border at 4px radius.

findings.what: The lime button is correct as the single main action, but its label is very large and spaced out, it is bigger than the 32px title, and the 'enter' keycap inside it is tiny. The button fights the title instead of leaving boldness to one place.
findings.fix: Set the label to 32px f-cond 800 with no extra letter-spacing. Set the 'enter' hint to 16px on an --acc-ink chip. Keep the button 64px tall and add --acc-hover and --acc-press states.

v.verdict: The old world-space station-label screen is now a proper centred pre-raid card with an x, one lime primary button and clear columns, but it is crowded, the type sizes are too small and uneven, and the map is an empty-looking block of boxes.

findings.where: pack list rows (medkit to compact smg), prices, belt, no-armour warning
findings.what: Much of the text is below the 16px floor: the price chips (about 13px, red on dark), the '/1' column, the belt digits, 'no armour equipped' (about 13px amber) and the 'pack 0 packed' label. The red prices read as errors instead of costs, and the red is too dim against the panel.
findings.fix: Set every row value to 16px minimum and row names to 20px. Show prices in tx-1 at 16px. Use --danger only on the one row the player cannot afford, and put a 'cannot afford' state on that row instead of colouring the whole column. Set the warning to 16px --warn.

findings.where: right column (kit, pack, belt, warning, ascend)
findings.what: The column is crowded. Kit cards, a 7-row stepper table with its own scrollbar, a belt strip, a warning and the CTA are stacked with uneven gaps (about 8 to 40px). The '+ / - / 0' steppers and price boxes are cramped boxes with different border weights. Scroll is hidden in the pack list.
findings.fix: Use 16px gaps between sections and one row height of 48px. Make the steppers 40x40 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the price column a fixed 96px, right-aligned. Move the belt into its own pane or collapse it. Keep the scrollbar but pad it 8px from the price column.

findings.where: map zone labels (the long dock, packing floor, chill row, scrap line, the sump)
findings.what: Zone names are bold white f-cond over the blue map at mixed sizes (about 18 to 24px), with no backing. 'foreman office' and 'blast freezer' (about 14px) sit tight against their purple dashed boxes, and 'the long dock' overlaps a room outline. The big zone rectangles are empty dark boxes, so the map reads as an unfinished wireframe.
findings.fix: Use one label style: 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 on a --scrim pill with 8px padding, placed 8px clear of any outline. Put the 14px keyed-room labels on the same pill style at 16px. Fill the room boxes with a --ui-raised tint at 40% and add small loot or door glyphs so they are not blank.

findings.where: header and subheader ('pre-raid', 'cold storage', 'ascending here', stat line)
findings.what: There are three competing titles. 'pre-raid' is about 28px, 'cold storage' about 24px, and the 'ascending here' chip carries a tick and a border while the stat line (420 x 340 m ...) is a 16px tx-2 row on the far right at low contrast. The hierarchy is muddled and nothing is the hero.
findings.fix: Make 'pre-raid' the 32px f-cond 700 title. Make 'cold storage' 20px tx-1 as the subtitle. Fold the stat line into a 16px tx-2 line directly under the subtitle on the left, and make 'ascending here' a quiet 16px label with no border.

findings.what: The radio rows use two different selected treatments: a lime tick in a circle plus a raised fill, with no lime bar and a faint border. '+5% sp' is tx-2 at about 16px and low contrast. Section labels (conditions, surface, weather, seed) are about 15px, close to the row text in size and weight, so the groups do not separate.
findings.fix: Give the selected row a 3px --acc left bar plus a --ui-raised fill, and give idle rows a 1px --ui-line border. Set group labels to 16px tx-2 with +.04em tracking and a 24px top gap. Set '+5% sp' to tx-1 at 16px.

findings.what: This is the right primary action, but the 'enter' key chip is about 14px and sits on lime in a dark box that is hard to read. The word 'ascend' uses a heavier, wider face than the rest of the UI, with letter-spacing that looks different from the title type.
findings.fix: Set 'ascend' in f-cond 800 at 32px with the same tracking as the titles. Make the key chip 16px, --acc-ink on a 1px --acc-ink border with no dark fill, aligned 24px from the right edge. Keep the button at 64px high.

findings.where: footer legend (esc close, click pick) and x button
findings.what: The footer legend is about 16px and left-aligned, but it is separated from the card edge by a thin rule and sits very low (y about 990). The x is a 48px box with a heavy white border that is brighter than anything else in the header.
findings.fix: Set the legend in 16px tx-2 with the chips at 24px high, 24px from the bottom edge. Make the x border 1px --ui-line-hi, and show a lime border only on focus.

findings.what: The outer area is a near-black void with only a faint card edge and no scrim difference, so the card does not lift. The card is also about 90% wide, as ordered, but the bottom gutter (about 55px) is larger than the top and side gutters.
findings.fix: Use --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) over the dimmed world, give the card a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and make the gutters 5% on every side.

v.verdict: The screen is coherent and lower case, and the lime 'ascend' button reads clearly as the primary action. But the map is a flat grid of empty dark boxes that fills the largest area, and the three columns are crowded with small, low-contrast text and uneven type sizes.

findings.where: map panel (left, about 65% of the card)
findings.what: The map is the largest element, so the eye goes there first. It shows only identical empty dark rectangles with thin outlines. It carries no information or art, and the lime button is the only competing focal point.
findings.fix: Put loot, spawn and tier markers or room fills on the map. Otherwise shrink the map to about 50% of the card width and give the freed space to conditions and kit. Cut the rectangle outline opacity by about 40% so the exit markers and zone names carry the map.

findings.where: map zone labels (the long dock, foreman office, blast freezer, chill row, scrap line)
findings.what: The labels are a dark-outlined white condensed face at about 16px, and they overlap or touch rectangle borders. 'foreman office' runs into its box edge and 'blast freezer' butts against the purple marker. They look pasted on and are not set in the same type as the rest of the UI.
findings.fix: Set labels in f-cond 600 at 16px with a 4px padding plate, fill --ui-panel at 80%. Keep at least 8px clear of every box edge and marker, and stop using the outline stroke.

findings.what: The rows are dense, with a 12px gap between the stepper and the price. Prices are small red or white 14px text with no pattern (red where unaffordable, white for $660, blank for the rest). The '/1' cap is faint, and the empty price cells on smoke canister and burst carbine look broken. A scrollbar is jammed against the price column.
findings.fix: Use a fixed 5-column grid: name, cap, stepper, price. Right-align every price at 16px, and show '$0' or a dash when there is no price. Give the stepper buttons 32px hit targets, raise the '/1' to --tx-2 at 16px, and add 8px padding before the scrollbar.

findings.what: Section labels (conditions, surface, weather, seed, kit, pack, belt) are about 14-16px, muted, and hard to tell apart from the row text. 'conditions' and 'surface' stack with no hierarchy. The belt numbers and the keycap hints are about 12px, under the 16px floor. The 'no armour equipped' warning is about 13px.
findings.fix: Give all section labels one style: f-cond 700 at 16px, +.04em, --tx-2. Make 'conditions' a header and drop 'surface' to a plain sub-label. Raise the belt numerals and the warning text to 16px minimum, and the esc/click keycaps to 16px.

findings.what: The title 'pre-raid' is smaller than the 32px spec and sits close to the top edge. The 'cold storage' sub-title is almost the same size, so the two titles compete. The footer legend (esc close, click pick) is small and floats alone with a large empty band beside it.
findings.fix: Make 'pre-raid' 32px f-cond 700 and 'cold storage' 20px with --tx-1. Raise the footer legend to 16px and align it to the 24px inner margin. Reduce the bottom empty band.

findings.what: Lime is used for the check circles, the left bars on selected rows and the button, which is correct. But the kit tile 'my loadout' and the conditions rows use the same raised fill and border as the idle tiles, so selection depends only on a small check. The lime bar on the green-barred pack rows (rarity) is the same hue family and reads as the same signal.
findings.fix: Give a selected row a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill, and leave unselected rows with a --ui-line border. Change the pack-row rarity bars to 3px and keep them out of lime-adjacent greens, or move them to the right of the icon.

findings.what: The lime fill is strong, but the label 'ascend' is in a wide, letter-spaced face that doesn't match the condensed UI type. The 'enter' keycap sits tight to the right edge. The button is jammed 16px under the warning row with no breathing room.
findings.fix: Set 'ascend' in f-cond 800 at 32px, left-aligned with 24px padding. Put an 8px inset on the 'enter' key hint, and add 24px of space above the button.

findings.what: The scrim is almost black with no visible content behind it, and the card has a thin border and nearly square 2px corners. The close x is a heavy outlined square that looks different from the other controls.
findings.fix: Use a 4px radius on the card and controls. Draw the x at 40px with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, matching the other icon buttons.
